core.title: Castletown Single Cylinder Entry Handleset, Weslock 7625

text.description_html:
Weslock 7625, Single Cylinder Castletown Handleset

The Castletown Single Cylinder Entry Handleset has an old world feel. The handleset's beveled edges and slightly curved handle grant it a simple grace that is an easy way to enhance the look of any door. Made of solid bronze, it is available in oil rubbed bronze or matte black finishes. It is an ANSI rated grade 2 lock. Easy to install, the Castletown Entryset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. There is an optional thick door kit that will accommodate doors with thicknesses from 2 inches to 2-1/4 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A single cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from the exterior and a thumbturn from the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior.

Single Cylinder Handleset: From the exterior, a thumb piece operates the latch and a key operates the deadbolt. From the interior, the knob operates the latch and a thumbturn operates the deadbolt.

Also available matching:

Castletown Dummy Handleset

This traditionally styled handleset is from the Weslock Molten Bronze Collection which features easy installation as well as lifetime mechanical and finish warranties. Meets ANSI grade 2 lock standards.

Features of the Castletown Single Cylinder Entry Handleset:

  • Material: solid molten bronze.
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard doors preparations with either 1-5/8" or 2-1/8" top and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/4" minimum center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Molten Bronze Castletown Entry Handleset:

  • Overall Exterior Length: 18-1/2"
  • Deadbolt Length (exterior and interior): 4"
  • Deadbolt Width (exterior and interior): 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Deadbolt Projection: 3/4"
  • Exterior Handle Length: 13-1/4"
  • Exterior Handle Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Exterior Top Handle Plate Length: 5"
  • Exterior Top Handle Plate Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Bottom Handle Plate Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Deadbolt Projection: 1-3/4"
  • Interior Plate Length: 5"
  • Interior Plate Width: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2" with optional thick door kit for doors 2" to 2-1/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
